items.html: Although there is an Atik in Beriah — that is, the TNHY of Atik, which were drawn together upon the screen of phase two, like all the Partzufim of Beriah — nevertheless these Mochin, which were drawn through this screen, were separated from the light of Hochma entirely, until they are discerned as the aspect of a light of an offshoot and not the essence. Therefore there is great importance to the descent of Malchut, to become the Atik of Beriah, for it did not pass through a screen, but pierced it; therefore its essence descended to shine in Beriah. (Part 2, Page 12, subheading "the GAR").

items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section XVI, List of Answers on Topics 299:56
items.html: See above, answer 83.

items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section XVI, List of Answers on Topics 299:57
items.html: The Yod-Hey are Aba and Ima, and the Vav-Hey are ZON. And as long as not all the discernments of the kings that were broken and died at the time of the breaking of the vessels are sorted, the Name is not complete, because the ZON, which are the Vav-Hey, descended to the depths of Atzilut, to VAK and a point. And in the future, after all the sortings are sorted, ZA will return to AA, and the Nukva to Aba and Ima, and then the Vav-Hey will clothe the Yod-Hey, and the Name will be complete. For then the Klipot will be abolished from the world, and there will no longer be any diminution to the Vav-Hey, and they will remain thus in permanence for ever and ever. (Item 246).

items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section XVI, List of Answers on Topics 299:58
items.html: The place of the Klipot in every world is beneath the concluding Malchut of every world, which is the place of the greatest darkness. However, just as there is a concluding Malchut of the totality, which is at the end of the feet, so there is a concluding Malchut of the particulars, called the skin, which surrounds the whole length of the stature; after the skin, there is the place of the greatest darkness, like after the end of the feet.

items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section XVI, List of Answers on Topics 299:59
items.html: Therefore, from the aspect of the totality, the Klipot are discerned as being beneath each world; and from the aspect of the particulars, they are discerned as surrounding each world. (Part 2, Page 20, subheading "around").

items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section XVI, List of Answers on Topics 299:60
items.html: Even before the sin, the Klipot existed — namely, the fourteen lower Sefirot from the Chazeh and below. However, there was no building in them at all, but only in the aspect of VAK and a point, for the male was VAK without a head, and the female lacked its first nine. And this is the secret of "he castrated the male and cooled the female." (Item 229).

items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section XVI, List of Answers on Topics 299:61
items.html: Before the sin, Aba and Ima received the Mochin of AB from AA, through the MA of the Mazal; and AA was found shining in Atzilut. However, after the sin, Aba and Ima descended from the mouth of AA and below, and it was found that AA — which is the AB of Atzilut — is hidden in Aba and Ima, for then Aba and Ima can receive only the illumination of SAG alone, and the AB does not shine to Atzilut. (Part 2, Page 22, subheading "the blemish").

items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section XVI, List of Answers on Topics 299:62
items.html: All the first nine of the Nukva of ZA come only from the Mochin of AB of the Mazal. And since these Mochin no longer shine, as above in answer 354, therefore the Nukva returned to the aspect of a point. (Part 2, Page 24, subheading "since").

items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section XVI, List of Answers on Topics 299:63
items.html: Because Beriah, when it was in Atzilut before the sin, was fit to receive Hochma like the Bina of Atzilut, which ascends to the GAR of AA and receives the Mochin of AB. However, after the sin, since Bina shines in Beriah only the aspect of Hassadim separated from Hochma, the illumination of AA and Aba — which are the Mochin of AB — is found lacking to her. And behold, all this loss of the Aba and Ima of Beriah was inherited by the Klipot of Beriah, in the secret of "I will fill the desolate," and from them were built the Aba and Ima of the Klipot. (Item 247).

items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section XVI, List of Answers on Topics 299:64
items.html: Because Yetzirah, before the sin, when it was in the ZA of Atzilut, served with the screen of phase three, and received the Mochin of AB from AA; and after the sin, when it fell below the Parsa, it remained in VAK without a head. And behold, all this loss was inherited by the Klipot opposite Yetzirah, and from them was built the AA of the Klipa. (Item 248).

items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section XVI, List of Answers on Topics 299:65
items.html: Assiyah, when it was in the Nukva of Atzilut before the sin, attained the aspect of Yechida, for it served there to draw the Mochin of Yechida to ZA, for therefore it ascended to AA. And now, after the sin, when it remained in the three-within-three, behold, all this loss was inherited by the Klipot opposite Assiyah, and from them was built the Atik of the Klipa of Assiyah. (Item 249).

items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section XVI, List of Answers on Topics 299:66
items.html: When he speaks in terms of BON, AA is discerned as Yechida, Aba and Ima as Chaya, and YESHSUT as Neshama. Therefore he says that in Beriah was added Ima, which is the Neshama, to the Klipot; in Yetzirah, Aba, which is of the aspect of Chaya; and in Assiyah, AA, which is the aspect of Yechida. And when he speaks from the aspect of MA, Atik is considered Yechida, AA as AB, and Aba and Ima as SAG. Therefore he says that in Beriah were added Aba and Ima to the Klipot; in Yetzirah, AA; and in Assiyah, Atik.

items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section XVI, List of Answers on Topics 299:67
items.html: Because at the time of the ascent of the worlds, the aspects of the Klipot that are opposite that world — which ascended to the one above it — are nullified. For example, at the time that the world of Assiyah ascends to Yetzirah, the aspect of Atik in the Klipot is nullified, for in Yetzirah there is no Atik for the Klipot. And likewise, at the time that Assiyah and Yetzirah ascend to Beriah, also the Partzuf of AA is nullified from the Klipot. And at the time that BYA ascend to Atzilut, also the Aba and Ima of the Klipot are nullified, and nothing remains but the aspect of the ZON of the Klipot, like in the Klipot of Atzilut. Hence, the Klipot diminish in direct relation with the ascent of the worlds. And at the completion of the correction, when also the ZON of the Klipa opposite Atzilut are nullified, then the feet of Atzilut will extend to BYA, and the worlds will return to the aspect of AK.

items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section XVI, List of Answers on Topics 299:68
items.html: These fourteen Sefirot are the aspect of the Klipot opposite Atzilut, for even before the sin, after all of BYA ascended to Atzilut, nevertheless these fourteen Sefirot remained as a permanent dwelling place for the Klipot. Hence they are the aspect of the ZON opposite Atzilut.

items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section XVI, List of Answers on Topics 299:69
items.html: The vessels of the circles and of the line of the Makifim come from the ZON that were separated from the head; therefore they became fit for surrounding vessels, for the circles cling only to the GAR, which is the head. However, the aspect of the ZON that were separated from the body did not become actual surrounding vessels, but the aspect of external vessels, which are also Makifim of Chaya and Yechida, like the ZON of the head. Only that the Makifim cannot clothe in them literally, but they receive only an illumination from the surrounding lights.
